map.由月债务与月收入求债务收入比: Debt-to-Income Ratio from Monthly Debt and Income
map.输入月债务支出与月收入，求债务收入比。: Enter monthly debt payments and monthly income to find the debt-to-income ratio.
map.📖 查看「由月债务与月收入求债务收入比 使用指南」: View "Debt-to-Income Ratio from Monthly Debt and Income User Guide"
map.DTI=月债务支出÷月收入，常见警戒线 43%~50%，越低偿债压力越小。仅含房: DTI = monthly debt / monthly income; the common warning line is 43%–50%, and lower means less repayment pressure. It includes only debt payments such as mortgage, auto loan and credit-card minimum, not daily consumption.
map.申请房贷前自测偿债能力是否达标。: Self-test repayment capacity before applying for a mortgage.
map.银行授信时评估月供占收入的安全边界。: Banks assess the safe boundary of monthly payment versus income when granting credit.
map.规划新增贷款前控制整体负债水平。: Control overall debt level before planning new loans.
map.月债务 8,000、月收入 20,000 的 DTI: DTI for monthly debt 8,000, monthly income 20,000
map.DTI=月债务支出÷月收入=8,000÷20,000=40%。多数银行要求房贷: DTI = monthly debt / monthly income = 8,000/20,000 = 40%. Most banks require mortgage DTI not above 50% (including this loan's payment); 40% is acceptable but with limited room.
map.常见警戒线为 43%~50%。DTI 越高，发生逾期的风险越大；低于 36% 通: The common warning line is 43%–50%. Higher DTI means greater default risk; below 36% is usually seen as light repayment pressure.
map.标准 DTI 只算「债务性支出」（房贷、车贷、信用卡最低还款等），不计入吃饭、交: Standard DTI counts only debt payments (mortgage, auto loan, credit-card minimum, etc.), not daily consumption like food and transport. Some institutions use a separate 'DTI including living expenses' basis.
